answer: Admission auction: each epoch sells 250 entry slots; agents bid POA, the 250th bid sets the price; winners pay. A farmer needing 1,000 fakes must buy 1,000 seats at 40 POA, spending 40,000 POA an epoch, while the fakes wander between markets with no work to repay it. Each fake is only an echo of one operator, so the swarm bids against itself. Honest agents pay one bid for one seat, on a terrace of steps: 100 at 10, 100 at 25, 50 at 60.
